latestVersion.changelog:
AI Video Learn v1.0.0 — Initial Release

- Introduces the "AI Video Learn" tool to convert video clips into structured learning lessons using AI.
- Supports MP4, MOV, AVI, and WebM files up to 500MB; exported results are 1080p MP4.
- Provides a guided onboarding flow with automatic backend connection and token management.
- Enables chapter breakdown, summaries, and segment extraction from educational videos.
- Includes credit tracking, session management, and straightforward error handling.
- Offers clear workflows: upload, edit (with prompts), and export high-quality learning videos.
